description.en: Configure Windows hot corners, edge hiding, mouse gestures and window layouts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用便捷窗口设置 Windows 触发角、贴边隐藏、鼠标手势和窗口布局。

description.en: Keep DSH plugins working across host upgrades: reads official upgrade guides directly, scans plugin code for breaking changes, smoke-tests in memory, scaffolds five plugin forms. Agent-native skill, zero dependencies
description.zh: 主机升级后插件老坏？它读官方升级指南、扫代码找破坏性变更、内存里跑冒烟测试，还能一键生成五种插件骨架。

description.en: Competition-grade PPT design console for DeepSeek Harness, paired with the smart-ppt-designer skill: 19 visual systems to retrieve by content, 29 hard red lines that a failing design must be rebuilt against, a 13-step workflow, 32 ready commands, 18 animation recipes and 95 catalogued templates. Import a local .pptx and it extracts the cover and summarises the deck structure (page outline, imagery and data it expects, theme colours); templates are browsed with inline thumbnails, and one click copies the assembled generation brief for the skill to execute. Latest (1.8.0): structure summary on import, opt-in model analysis, ppt-effects 1.2.0 recipes (18 total), truthful template availability reporting, and a theme-following ambient background.
description.zh: 国赛/创赛级 PPT 设计台，配合 smart-ppt-designer 技能使用：19 套视觉系统按内容检索、29 条硬红线（违反即返工）、13 步工作流、32 条命令、18 条动效、95 份模板清单。导入本地 .pptx 会自动抽取封面，并生成结构速览（页面框架、需要的素材与数据、主题色）；模板内联缩略图预览，一键复制组装好的生成指令交给技能执行。最新 1.8.0：导入即出结构速览、可选 AI 深度分析、并入 ppt-effects 1.2.0（共 18 条动效）、模板可用性如实上报、随主题自适应的环境光背景。

description.en: 【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
description.zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

description.en: DSH iOS移动伴侣：iPhone/iPad 扫码连接 DSH 桌面端，局域网直连 + Cloudflare Tunnel 固定域名远程两种通道
A data-driven card board for DeepSeek Harness: scripts write small JSON cards, the Web UI shows each person the boards they may see.
description.zh: 脚本写 JSON 卡片，插件自动生成数据看板，每个人看自己的面板

description.en: 基于dsh的rp卡自动编写插件，当前支持风月（fengyue.ai）平台
description.zh: 把一句话想法自动做成能直接导入平台开玩的 RP 卡，支持风月平台，分步人工验证。

description.en: Portable DSH environment setup and profile migration for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Foxy's Weibo transport for DeepSeek Harness: follow users, read posts, comment, reply, and remember events.
DSH Remote（个人分支）bundle 插件：手机连接入口、首次连接提示与浏览器管理控制台；内置网关自动启停，支持手机远程会话、审批、文件互传、语音输入和设备管理。

dsh-voice-say：把一句话合成语音（本机 Breeze TTS 2，离线免费）。上传一段音频就是嗓子——逐字转写可以不用手打，插件用本地 faster-whisper 自动听写（也可自己指定 python / 装识别环境）；主参数两个——instructions（自然语言写「怎么说话」）与 guidanceScale；18 个风格可叠加；音色可存库、可指定 QQ 桥接用哪个嗓子（设了就只认它，文件丢了直接报错不退回默认）。合成前「读音导演」按人设、当下情绪与对话情节重排标点（只动标点不改字）。Q
Unofficial OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT subscription sign-in.
DSH 会话回收站：会话详情归档入口、回收站多选还原/彻底删除、活跃会话保护。 · Session trash & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给会话加个回收站，当前会话一键移入，误删的能恢复，不要的也能彻底删掉。

description.en: Use locally authenticated coding subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness model providers.
A notification inbox for DeepSeek Harness: each person sees their own notifications with read and unread, gets Web Push on their phone or browser, and can act on them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个通知收件箱，按人区分已读未读，还能推送到手机和浏览器，每条通知都带操作按钮。

description.en: Desktop blue fish pet for DeepSeek Harness: per-pixel transparent WinForms window, text chat, and cloud speech-to-text voice conversation.
Approval-gated behavioural self-evolution for the DSH personal assistant.

Cortex workbench for DeepSeek Harness: the original Cortex UI (vulnerabilities, client findings, assets, internal operations, Memory Nebula, snapshots, retest, standalone Web Fuzzer with raw/JSON/render responses, mini-program reversing), project/selected
Capture independently accepted tool workflows and replay versioned skills through the current native Goal and tool authority.
dsh plugin: SYSTEM proxy (env) + LLM traffic-splitting proxy via a process-global undici routing dispatcher
description.zh: 把 LLM 请求按配置分流到指定代理，其余流量走系统代理，没配就直连。

description.en: Lightweight, self-contained desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — an in-app floating pet driven by session activity, a settings panel, and a transparent always-on-top window that reuses the DSH host's Electron runtime (path resolution mirrors dsh-pet).
思考小窗：贴边深呼吸箭头、思考增量翻译；设置页可选官方 Bing/Google/DeepSeek 或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持拉取模型列表与连接测试，本地端点走宿时代理绕过 CORS。
A learning whiteboard for handwritten notes, screenshots, AI summaries, editable infographics, and spaced review, with a companion Chrome extension for taking notes while reading.
description.zh: 在画布上记录手写笔记和截图，生成 AI 图文总结与可编辑信息图，用间隔复习巩固知识，并通过配套 Chrome 扩展收集网页笔记。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 灵动岛（DSH Go 版）：输入框状态条、用量面板、每轮费用估计——原生插件，零依赖
description.zh: 在 DSH Go 里给输入框加状态条和用量面板，每轮花费一眼看清，原生零依赖。

description.en: GitHub Trending masonry feed in the DSH sidebar: daily, weekly and monthly boards with category chips, concise project intros, and one-click starring that syncs to your GitHub account or saves to a local collection. It reads github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com, sends README excerpts to your current model and text to Google Translate when a translation is needed, and stars with the GitHub token you connect (or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN); its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 带侧边栏的 GitHub Trending 瀑布流：日/周/月三榜加分类标签，简明扼要的项目简介，一键加星可同步到 GitHub 账号或存入本地收藏。它会读取 github.com 与 raw.githubusercontent.com，把 README 摘录发给当前模型、需要翻译时把文本发给 Google Translate，并用你连接的 GitHub 令牌（或 GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN）加星；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Scheduled npm updates for the plugins installed in a DSH profile: checks dist-tags on a timer, installs one package at a time and applies it without restarting, taking a snapshot before each install, with per-package rollback, failure suppression for a package version that failed, a cross-process lock, update notices, a bilingual settings page that saves instantly, and automatic retention cleanup of history and logs (3 days by default).
description.zh: 定时检查 DSH 已装插件的 npm 新版本，逐个安装并就地生效，不用重启；每次安装前留快照，可按包回滚，某个版本失败后一段时间内不再重试，带跨进程锁和更新提醒；设置页中英双语、改动即存，并自动清理超过保留期的更新记录与运行日志（默认 3 天）。

description.en: Hold-to-talk chat between an Android smartwatch and the DeepSeek Harness running on the phone it is paired with: the watch uploads a WAV recording to the bridge, which transcribes it locally with the speech-to-text service the host already has, answers through a real DSH session, and returns the reply as WAV for playback; the watch APK ships inside the package and is served at /watch/app.apk.
description.zh: 安卓手表与手机上的 DeepSeek Harness 之间的按住说话对话：手表把 WAV 录音上传到网桥，网桥用主机自带的语音识别本地转写、经真实 DSH 会话作答，再把回复合成为 WAV 播回手表；手表 APK 随包分发，由 /watch/app.apk 直接下载。

description.en: Plays a Bilibili live room or video behind the DSH chat UI. Scan a QR code in the settings page to sign in with your own account, which unlocks the original quality tier for live streams; anonymous requests fall back to the best tier the public API returns. Live picks HLS ts segments over fmp4 so the muxed AAC track keeps audio and video in sync, and re-resolves by itself when a stream URL expires or the host reopens. Videos support part switching, a seek bar, resume position per video and part, and a configurable end action (play next part, loop, stop on the last frame, or turn the background off). Frame cover/contain, background blur, darkening scrim, panel opacity, volume and playback rate are adjustable, and playback pauses while the window is hidden. A Host-side proxy carries the Referer the CDN requires, rewrites HLS playlists, and signs every media URL with HMAC-SHA256 restricted to an allowlist of Bilibili CDN hosts.
description.zh: 把 B 站直播间或视频当作 DSH 聊天界面的背景。在设置页扫码用你自己的账号登录，直播即可解锁原画档；未登录时取公开接口能给的最高一档。直播优先选 HLS 的 ts 分片而非 fmp4，音轨混在分片里，音画天然同步；直播地址过期或主播下播后重开，会自动重新解析。视频支持分P 切换、拖动进度条、按「视频 + 分P」记住进度，以及可配置的播完动作（播下一P、循环、停在最后一帧、关闭背景）。可调铺满/完整、背景模糊、压暗遮罩、面板不透明度、音量与播放速度，窗口不可见时自动暂停。Host 端代理补上 CDN 要求的 Referer、改写 HLS 清单，并用 HMAC-SHA256 给每个媒体地址签名，且只允许 B 站 CDN 的域名白名单。

description.en: Manages skills and MCP servers at global, project, and session scope: reads skill folders from 15 sources (DSH, the shared .agents folder, and 13 coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor), switches a whole source or a single skill on and off, adds extra skill folders, creates, edits, and deletes skills, connects stdio or HTTP MCP servers, and lets the composer pick which skills and servers one message carries.
description.zh: 在全局、项目、会话三级管理 skill 与 MCP 服务器：读取 15 个来源的技能目录（DSH、通用 .agents 目录，以及 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 13 个编程 agent），可按整个来源或单个技能启停、添加额外的技能目录、新建编辑删除技能、连接本地进程或 HTTP 的 MCP 服务器，并能在输入框里为某一次发送单独选择带上哪些技能与服务器。

description.en: Transparent Markdown long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, combining the two ideas that work in OpenClaw and Hermes: files you own and can read, edit, diff and back up, plus a background loop that keeps them current. SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENT.md and AGENTS.md are injected as one bounded system-prompt section; MEMORY.md is split into Core / Important / General tiers and retrieved on demand through a local BM25 index (Chinese single-character and bigram tokenization, English words) instead of being pasted into every prompt. A single-concurrency async worker extracts durable preferences and facts from committed messages, dedupes them, refines the tiers, and archives overflow to MEMORY.archive.md; writes are atomic and failures are contained. Ships four strict tools (memory_read, memory_search, memory_update, persona_update), a Settings → Hybrid memory panel with per-file Load/Inject switches, budgets, search and manual extract/pulse, an optional sidebar panel, and a heartbeat that can wake an idle agent with a producer-owned message kind. Local-first, no embedding service, no vector database, no extra dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供透明的 Markdown 长期记忆，把 OpenClaw 的文件透明与 Hermes 的后台闭环合在一起：文件归你所有，可读、可改、可 diff、可备份；后台循环负责持续维护。SOUL.md、USER.md、AGENT.md、AGENTS.md 作为一个有预算的系统提示片段注入；MEMORY.md 分成 Core / Important / General 三层，用本地 BM25（中文单字 + 二元组、英文单词）按需检索，而不是每轮整篇塞进上下文。单并发异步 worker 从已提交消息中提炼稳定偏好与事实，去重、分层，把溢出归档到 MEMORY.archive.md；写入原子化，失败只降级不打断对话。附带四个严格工具（memory_read、memory_search、memory_update、persona_update）、Settings → Hybrid memory 设置页（逐文件 Load/Inject 开关、预算、搜索、立即提炼/心跳）、可选侧边栏，以及可用 producer-owned message kind 唤醒空闲 Agent 的心跳。本地优先，不需要向量库或额外依赖。

description.en: Serial-port capture and troubleshooting for DeepSeek Harness: lossless recordings with a SQLite index, incremental tail, byte-level lookup, workspace scan marks and a live FSM middleware, plus a web panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的串口抓取与排障插件：无损录制与 SQLite 索引、增量读取、字节级回查、工作区扫描标记、实时状态机中间件，并提供 Web 面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Indexed full-text excerpt search through AI4Scholar with a dedicated reading workspace, source-type filters and saved offline HTML/CSV reports; optional AI synthesis preserves original passages and source metadata.
description.zh: 通过 AI4Scholar 检索已索引的全文片段，提供独立阅读工作台、来源类型筛选与本地 HTML/CSV 报告；可用 AI 整理已有报告，同时保留原文与来源信息。

description.en: Back up and restore a whole DSH environment (installed plugins, DSH and plugin settings, skills, sessions and explicitly registered workspace files) into one private GitHub repository. Multiple machines share a single repo through per-device namespaces that never overwrite each other, and a pull can restore from this device, the latest backup or a chosen device. Push previews a read-only plan before writing, pull backs up local data first, secret-looking settings are redacted and key files are never uploaded. It calls api.github.com with the GitHub token you save in the panel (kept host-side only); its HTTP routes (/one-pack/api/...) require DSH browser auth.
description.zh: 把整套 DSH 环境（已装插件、DSH 与插件设置、技能、会话、显式登记的工作区文件） 打包同步到一个私有 GitHub 仓库。多台设备共用同一仓库时各写自己的设备命名空间、 互不覆盖，拉取可选本设备、最新备份或指定设备；推送前先只读预览计划，拉取前自动 备份本地数据；疑似密钥字段写成掩码、密钥文件硬排除，GitHub token 只保存在 Host 本地。它会用面板里保存的 token 访问 api.github.com；HTTP 路由 （/one-pack/api/…）要求 DSH 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: A control center for DSH plugins: keep plugins that claim the same tool or command installed, see dependencies and conflicts, fix common conflicts in one click, roll back, choose which implementation a tool or agent uses, limit which tools an agent can call, and view call counts and latency.
description.zh: DSH 插件控制中心：抢同一个工具或命令的插件可以同时保留，一页看清依赖和冲突、一键修复常见问题、随时回滚；还能按 Agent 选择工具实现、限制 Agent 能调用哪些工具，并查看调用次数和延迟。

description.en: Declares the vision input modality for Alibaba Cloud Bailian (Model Studio) Token Plan routes in the pi-ai model catalog, so models the vendor documents as image-capable stop being rejected with "the current model does not support images".
description.zh: 在 pi-ai 模型目录里为阿里百炼 Token Plan 路由声明视觉输入模态，官方标注支持图片的模型不再被「当前模型不支持图片」拦下。

description.en: Review agent-proposed edits to personal Markdown documents: the agent proposes changes, and the user accepts or rejects each suggestion. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 审阅 Agent 对个人 Markdown 文档提出的修改建议，逐条接受或拒绝。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A Bot team for DeepSeek Harness: each Bot keeps its own role prompt, project memory, avatar and id, and a sidebar roster shows who is idle, who is working, and who is waiting for your review. The lead dispatches a task to one Bot, which works in its own subagent session and returns a result the lead accepts or rejects with a grade that counts toward that Bot's experience; rules taught to a Bot are written into its project memory, and a Bot accumulating experience gains levels and can be promoted. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一支 Bot 团队：每只 Bot 有自己的职责提示、项目记忆、头像和 ID，侧边栏成员卡显示谁在待命、谁在干活、谁等你验收。领队把活派给某只 Bot，它在自己的子会话里干完回结果，领队按交付物验收并给评分，评分折算成它的经验；教给它的规矩写进它的项目记忆，经验攒够就升级、还能升阶。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Google-official parameter passthrough for Gemini requests on DSH's native google route: safety thresholds, X-Server-Timeout, serviceTier and a whitelisted generationConfig, editable from a panel on the plugin's detail page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上使用的 Google Gemini 添加 Google 官方支持的自定义参数透传（Gemini 请求体修复），可用于调整官方安全参数、延长超时时长以增强长周期任务稳定性等。

description.en: DSH plugin and CLI that turn a Git project into a browsable feature-flow graph with source evidence, annotations, flow drafts and implementation reports. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 Git 项目整理成可浏览的功能线路图，带源码证据、批注、流程草稿和实现报告。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Single-chat multi-workspace context router for DSH: IDF routing, structured memory, budgeted context, per-workspace policies, migration, and an inspectable panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 单聊天框多工作区上下文路由：IDF 路由、结构化记忆、预算化上下文、每区策略、迁移与可解释面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）社区插件：统一管理工具与技能的常驻、按需和禁用策略，提供重复调用提醒、交替循环识别、无进展局部保护及本次启动统计。
description.zh: 统一管理工具和技能的常驻、按需与禁用策略，自动识别重复调用和死循环，防止 AI 空转。

description.en: DSH Go 原生插件：自动找到手机上的 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接 · Native dsh-go plugin: finds the phone's ADB TCP port and keeps adb connected
description.zh: 自动找到手机 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接，在 DSH 的 bash 里直接 adb shell 用。

description.en: Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archive, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall, 1600-token memory snapshot. ｜ 陪伴 AI 冷热分层记忆：全自动归档 + 渐进冷存 + 线索召回。
description.zh: 给陪伴 AI 加上冷热分层记忆，自动归档对话、渐进冷存、按线索召回，省 token 不忘事。

description.en: Grape DevOps pipeline tools for DeepSeek Harness: 33 tools in nine groups trigger and monitor pipelines, run the issue lifecycle from create to cancel, browse scenes, managed repositories, project templates, skills and knowledge, and read ops dashboards through the grape CLI.
description.zh: Grape 的 DeepSeek Harness DevOps 工具集：九个工具组共 33 个工具，触发并跟踪流水线、走完从创建到取消的 issue 生命周期、浏览场景/托管仓库/项目模板/技能与知识库、读取运维概览，全部经由 grape CLI 调用。

description.en: Local-first talent-matching workbench: 19 versioned assessment dimensions, 13 role templates with adjustable weights, batch resume import with agent-extracted fields, a per-dimension derivation you can trace, and a local anonymous exchange ledger. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 本地优先的人才匹配工作台：19 个可版本化考察维度、13 个可调权重的岗位模板、智能体识别字段的批量简历导入、逐维可回溯的推导，以及本地匿名交换账本。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: An interactive 3D atlas of solid-state and atomic physics: 53 bilingual entries across crystal structures, Bravais lattices, atoms and orbitals, symmetry and lattice dynamics, with stepped lessons, quizzes, per-entry notes and local CIF import.
description.zh: 固体物理与原子物理的交互式 3D 图鉴：53 条中英双语条目，覆盖晶体结构、布拉维格子、原子与轨道、对称与晶格动力学，配分步讲解、测验、逐条笔记与本地 CIF 导入。

description.en: Auto safety checks after every capability change - GPU/VRAM, stuck jobs, plugin health, version channels, core chain, system resources, error fingerprints and guardian self-health - with safe auto-fixes and explained non-fixes, plus a safe_trial_run sandbox that rehearses new software before it touches the real machine.
description.zh: 每次新增或升级能力后自动安全检查（显存、卡死任务、插件健康、版本通道、核心链、系统资源、错误指纹与卫士自健康），能安全修的自动修、不能修的解释原因；另带 safe_trial_run 试跑沙箱，新软件先在隔离环境跑几遍再上真机。

description.en: Digital-human workbench skin for the DSH web UI: an idle avatar video loops beside an embedded, unchanged native DSH conversation view, with an optional voice mode. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的数字人工作台外壳：空闲数字人视频在会话旁循环播放，嵌入式复用原生 DSH 视图不改动业务流，语音为可选。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Market Dog, the plugin bloodhound: locate the right plugin from a one-sentence or keyword description with bilingual (Chinese/English) semantic matching. Sort by relevance or downloads; filter by category, update time and stars.
description.zh: Market Dog（寻“plugin”猎犬）：根据一句话或关键词描述快速定位目标插件， 中英双语语义匹配，支持相关度、下载量排序及类别/更新时间/Star 筛选。

description.en: OAuth/OIDC sign-in for DSH Web -- GitHub, Google, GitLab, Gitee, Microsoft Entra, Discord, Slack, Keycloak/OIDC and Feishu/Lark, all configured in Settings -> OAuth with per-account allowlists that apply on the next request.
description.zh: 把登录墙搬进 DSH Web：GitHub、Google、GitLab、Gitee、Microsoft Entra、Discord、Slack、Keycloak·任意 OIDC、飞书·Lark 九种登录，全部在「设置 → OAuth」里配置，按账号白名单，改动下一个请求即生效。

description.en: Adds a Delete session row to the sidebar session menu: the confirmation dialog shows how much space the session and its backup copy take, and the backup, when enabled, can be restored or deleted from the plugin page afterwards. Also adds sidebar buttons for reloading the page and restarting the app. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里加「删除会话」：确认弹窗会显示该会话与备份副本各占多大，勾选的备份之后可在插件页里恢复或删除。另在侧栏底部加了「重载页面」与「重启应用」两个按钮。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Delivery budget for the composer — set 20 minutes and the model sees an exact remaining time before every step, ships a rough-but-usable version by the halfway point, and at the deadline stops starting new work and hands over what it has with the gaps written out. Adds a per-session timebox tool (status / request_more / deliver / stop) and a countdown pill under the input.
description.zh: 输入框下方设一个交付预算——每一步模型都能看到精确剩余时间，过半先出粗糙但可用的版本，到点停止开新工并交出产物与缺口说明；带按会话的 timebox 工具（status / request_more / deliver / stop）与输入框下方的倒计时胶囊。

description.en: Collects everything a task will need into one approval dialog, then remembers the approved keywords so similar commands stop prompting. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把一个任务需要的提权一次性问完，之后记住已批准的关键词，同类命令不再逐条询问。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Watches GitHub traffic and, only while GitHub is in use, probes the candidate edge addresses over TCP and TLS so a SYSTEM helper can pin the working one in the hosts file. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 监视 GitHub 流量，只在你访问 GitHub 时才用 TCP 与 TLS 探测候选边缘地址，再由 SYSTEM 助手把可用的那个钉进 hosts 文件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reads the Codex (ChatGPT) subscription quota already on your machine and draws with it: plan, weekly usage and reset time in a sidebar panel, one prompt to a PNG saved locally, with history. No API key, no extra billing. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 读取本机已有的 Codex（ChatGPT 订阅）额度并直接生图：侧栏显示套餐、本周已用与重置时间，写一句话出 PNG 存到本机并保留历史。不需要 API key，不额外计费。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Annotate elements in the right-Sidebar browser (Desktop): click one element or drag a marquee to select a region, then send DOM paths and a change request to the agent. Includes an action that opens a local HTML preview in the browser for annotation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 圈选右侧浏览器里的页面元素发给 AI：单击选一个，按住拖框选一片（弹窗、卡片组、工具条），自动带上 DOM 路径、坐标和文本；HTML 预览可直接一键转到浏览器里标注。仅桌面端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Auto-approves sandbox escalations that clearly belong to a Minecraft mod build, learns keywords from every human approval, and reports how often approvals fire.
description.zh: 只自动放行明显属于 Minecraft 模组构建的沙箱提权，从每次人工批准里学习关键词，并统计审批触发频次。

description.en: Persistent C/C++ symbol index for DeepSeek Harness: symbol search, go-to-definition, find-references, callers/callees, call graph and a right-sidebar panel, plus @ symbol completion in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 C/C++ 符号索引：符号搜索、跳转定义、引用、调用者/被调用者、调用关系图与右侧栏面板，以及输入框 @ 符号补全。

description.en: Nested workspaces in the sidebar: double-click the section title to rename it, add a child workspace that is created inside the parent folder, drag a session onto another workspace to file it there (a view assignment, the session working directory does not change), reorder sibling workspaces by dragging, and pin sessions; session rows also show a relative last-used time.
description.zh: 侧栏的嵌套工作区：双击分区标题即可改名；添加的子工作区直接建在父目录里；可以把会话拖到别的工作区归档（只是视图归属，会话的工作目录不变）；同级工作区可拖动排序；会话可置顶，会话行显示最近使用时间。

description.en: Adds one button to the composer toolbar that turns the model thinking on or off on each click, cycling between off and the last reasoning level it used.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行加一个按钮：点一下关闭模型思考，再点一下回到上次的思考档位，如此循环。

description.en: A WeRead reading desk: monthly book plan and calendar, FSRS-scheduled highlight review, notes with AI summaries, a monthly reading exhibition and reading statistics. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 微信读书阅读台：月度书单与日历、按 FSRS 排期的划线回顾、带 AI 摘要的笔记、月度阅读展与阅读统计。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH management plugin for the MetaOntic AI unified API gateway, with a model plaza, grouped API key quotas and copying, subscriptions, top-ups and balance/usage queries; the platform aggregates models with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini compatibility, layered quotas, isolated personal/team allocations and centralized request records.
description.zh: MetaOntic AI 统一 AI 接口网关的 DSH 管理插件，提供模型广场、API Key 分组与额度管理、复制、订阅充值和余额用量查询；平台聚合多家模型，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Gemini 协议，支持分层额度、个人与团队配额隔离及集中调用记录。

description.en: Multi-phase agent workflow runner: a workflow is a YAML file of phases, links, gates and expected artifacts; a run takes one requirement input and works through the links in order, and the panel shows per-link progress, gate scores, rework counts and produced files. Registers workflow_list, workflow_get, workflow_validate and workflow_save so an agent can read, validate and save workflows.
description.zh: 多阶段 agent 工作流：工作流是含阶段、环节、门禁与期望产物的 YAML 文件，运行时只输入一次需求并按环节依次推进；面板展示每环节进度、门禁得分、返工次数与产物文件，并提供 workflow_list、workflow_get、workflow_validate、workflow_save 四个工具，让 agent 读取、校验与保存工作流。

description.en: Adds a Bocha web-search provider to DSH with a General Settings switch for routing searches between Bocha and DeepSeek.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供博查网页搜索 provider，并在通用设置中用开关在博查与 DeepSeek 之间切换搜索来源。

description.en: Folds every left-sidebar panel entry into a single "Collection" row, and keeps the per-entry hide/show switches. Hovering the row slides out a 448px two-column card: the panel entries come first, then the shell's own overflow entries (browse plugins, create a plugin), dealt row by row into the same grid — no divider, no extra group, no nested popup. The first click never navigates: with nothing selected the row only reveals the card. Picking an entry selects it and opens that panel exactly like its own row would; the row then reads "Collection / \[icon] name" and clicking it goes straight there, while hovering still lets you switch. Keyboard: arrows walk the visual order, left/right move within a row, Enter opens, Esc closes and returns focus. Collapsing the sidebar to a 36px rail leaves only the collection glyph plus a dot when something is selected. A switch in Settings → Left menu turns the whole thing off and restores the plain row list; the user's own hidden set is never rewritten.
description.zh: 把左侧菜单的每个面板入口收进一行「集合」，同时保留逐项的隐藏/显示开关。悬浮这一行会从右侧滑出一张 448px 双列卡片：面板入口在前，外壳自己的溢出条目（浏览更多插件、创建你的插件）在后，一起逐行铺进同一个网格——没有分隔线、没有额外分组、没有第二层弹窗。首次点击不会跳转：还没选过任何入口时，这一行只把卡片打开。选中某一项既记下选择、也像点原来那一行一样打开该面板；行文字随即变成「集合 / 图标 名称」，再点它就直接过去，悬浮仍然可以换。键盘：方向键按视觉顺序走，左右在同一行里挪，Enter 打开，Esc 关闭并把焦点还给行。侧栏折叠成 36px 图标轨时只留集合图标，有选中项时点一个小圆点。设置 → 左栏菜单里的开关可以整体关掉、恢复原来的一行一个；用户自己的隐藏集合不会被改写。

description.en: Adds a /clear command that opens a new session in the current session's Workspace and switches to it, leaving the old session in the sidebar. It starts a new session rather than clearing context in place.
description.zh: 新增 /clear 命令：在当前会话所在的工作区新开一个会话并切换过去，原会话留在侧边栏。是新开会话，不是原地清空上下文。

description.en: Turns the last 30 days (7 / 30 / 90 selectable) of Session failures into an error museum, with each hall grouping failures by what the model did next (restored, retried verbatim, handed back, stalled) and every exhibit keeping the calls before and after plus the verbatim error. Logs are read locally, and only the selected Session's summary reaches the configured model when you press audit.
description.zh: 把最近 30 天（可切 7 / 30 / 90 天）的会话可确认失败做成「错误博物馆」，展品按模型失败后的处置（复原 / 重试 / 交还 / 搁置）分馆陈列，保留失败前后的调用与错误原文。会话日志只在本机读取，只有点「用模型深挖」时才把该会话摘要发给已配置的模型。

description.en: Local SQLite mold lifecycle management with inspection, maintenance, repair, usage, scrap, and inventory workflows. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 本地 SQLite 模具全生命周期管理，覆盖点检、保养、维修、领用归还、报废和盘点。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Connects Nezha Monitoring's built-in MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, adding tools for server status, one-shot commands, remote file read/write/delete and large-file transfer links, with a settings page for the dashboard URL and PAT.
description.zh: 把哪吒监控内置的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，新增服务器状态、一次性命令执行、远程文件读写/删除和大文件传输链接等工具，并提供管理面板地址与 PAT 的设置页。

description.en: Check that a DSH plugin package is installable and findable before you publish it. The catalog most common rejection is a package.json that declares only dsh.client — that alone is not installable, and dsh plugin add fails. The quieter failure this check earns its place with: everything declared, the patch file present, but files drops the patch, so the package runs locally and breaks for everyone who installs it. Fifteen rules, all decidable from the package directory: dsh.bundle.patch declared and present, the patch mounting this package or one of its declared dependencies, files not dropping the patch or docs/DETAIL.md, engines.dsh, a bin key equal to the package name so npx does not 404, a README with an install line, and the locale and icon that decide whether the plugin card shows a title or stays blank. No network, no running your code, no registry. Calibrated on seven plugins other people wrote that happen to be installed here, plus this kit own thirty packages — and it found that twenty-seven of them had blank cards and no install command in their README. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 发布前确认一个 DSH 插件包「装得上、找得到」。目录收录第一号打回理由是 package.json 只声明了 dsh.client——那样装不上；更隐蔽的一种是都声明了、patch 文件也在，但 files 没把它打进 tarball，于是本地能跑、发出去装不上，这个检查就是为它而写。十五条规则全部只看包目录：dsh.bundle.patch 声明了且在、patch 挂的是自己或自己声明的依赖、files 没漏掉 patch 或 docs/DETAIL.md、engines.dsh、bin 里有一个键等于包名（否则 npx 会 404）、README 里有安装命令、以及决定插件卡片是否有标题的 locale 与图标。不联网、不执行包代码、不读 registry。校准语料是这台机器上别人写的七个插件加本仓库自己的三十个包——它查出其中二十七个卡片是空白的、README 里也没有安装命令。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Connects the Gemus design canvas through DSH's MCP client, with an in-app key setup page; the agent can build node workflows, run image, video, 3D and slide generations, and read the results back. Needs a Gemus account and key (generations spend Gemus credits).
description.zh: 通过 DSH 的 MCP 客户端接入 Gemus 设计画布，附带应用内的 Key 配置页；agent 可以搭建节点工作流，运行图片、视频、3D 和幻灯片生成，并读回结果。需要 Gemus 账号与 Key（生成会消耗 Gemus 点数）。

description.en: Two-way messaging (cc-bridge) between DSH sessions and Claude Code sessions: the CC side needs zero setup (its built-in SendMessage reaches a named DSH session), the DSH side gets native cc_send / cc_who / cc_status tools, and incoming messages are pushed into the session within seconds.
description.zh: cc-bridge：DSH 会话与 Claude Code 会话互发消息：CC 侧零配置（自带 SendMessage 按会话名直达），DSH 侧注册 cc_send / cc_who / cc_status 原生工具，来件秒级推入会话。

description.en: Lets dsh-pet watch screen activity and live audio, then comment through its chat bubble and voice using dsh-see-now's capture pipeline.
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 实时看屏幕、听同期声音，并通过气泡和语音点评；采集与拼图复用 dsh-see-now。

description.en: Domain-agnostic whitebox project board with a persistent conversation box at every level (locked to the selected task), blueprint-driven layout, dynamic loading progress, SVG dependency flowchart, burndown, edit cards with diffs, voice input and auto TTS broadcast. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 领域无关项目白盒看板：每层保留对话框并锁定当前任务、蓝图驱动布局、动态加载进度、SVG依赖流程图、燃尽图、编辑卡diff、语音输入与自动播报。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
